title: INSITU: Reconstruction-Free Attention over a Compressed KV Cache on FPGA
description: Software and hardware artifact for INSITU: SystemVerilog attention engine for a Xilinx ZCU104, fixed-point NumPy reference, A53 firmware and host clients, golden vectors and tests, completed Llama-3.2-1B WikiText-2 bit-width sweep, and original board logs. The implemented cache uses four-bit keys and two-bit values. See docs/evidence.md for experiment protocols and limits of the archived measurements.
